title: MIFARE DESFire Cards
description: MIFARE DESFire cards for high-security multi-application credentials in transit, access control, loyalty and cashless payment environments.
summary: MIFARE DESFire cards are built for high-security multi-application credentials across transit, enterprise access, campus, loyalty and cashless payment deployments.

Interoperability: Built on open global standards, MIFARE DESFire cards work seamlessly with existing contactless infrastructures, ensuring compatibility across various systems and manufacturers.
